title: Refund, return & exchange policy
lead: At Casely, we want every customer to be happy with their purchase. If something goes wrong with your order, we're committed to working towards a fair resolution.
Please read our policy below before placing an order.

sections.heading: 1. Defective or damaged products
paragraphs: If you receive a product that is defective, damaged or materially different from what you ordered, you may be eligible for an exchange or refund. Examples include:
bullets: Product defects that affect the intended use of the case.

paragraphs: Customers should contact us within 48 hours of receiving their order and provide clear photographs or videos showing the issue.
Each case will be reviewed before a resolution is provided.

sections.heading: 2. Incorrect orders
paragraphs: If Casely supplies a different product or phone model from what was confirmed at checkout, we will work towards correcting the error at no additional cost to the customer.
Customers are responsible for selecting the correct phone model when placing an order.

sections.heading: 3. Delivery delays and undelivered orders
paragraphs: We understand that receiving your order on time matters.
If your order experiences a significant delay beyond the communicated delivery timeframe, please contact us for an update.
Where an order cannot be fulfilled or delivered within a reasonable period, customers may be eligible for a cancellation and refund.
If an order has not been delivered, customers should contact us so we can investigate and determine the appropriate resolution.

sections.heading: 4. Change of mind and custom orders
paragraphs: Because many of our products are made specifically for individual customers:
bullets: We do not generally accept returns or exchanges for change of mind.
Customised orders cannot be cancelled or modified once production has commenced.
Incorrect design details supplied or approved by the customer may not qualify for a refund or exchange.
This does not affect a customer's rights where a product is defective or the order has not been fulfilled as agreed.

sections.heading: 5. Refund processing
bullets: Approved refunds will be returned through the original payment method where possible.
Processing times may vary depending on the payment provider or financial institution.
Customers will be notified once a refund has been initiated.

sections.heading: 6. How to request a refund or exchange
paragraphs: To submit a request, contact Casely through our official customer service channels with:
bullets: A brief explanation of the issue.
Relevant photographs or videos, where applicable.

paragraphs: Our team will review the request and communicate the next steps.

sections.heading: 7. Contact information
paragraphs: For all refund, return or exchange enquiries, please contact:
We appreciate your patience and continued support.
